verdict.rationale: A probe found no llms.txt at fastmail.help (HTTP 404), and no OpenAPI spec exists at any candidate path. Fastmail does document JMAP's machine-readable session discovery and points to the IETF RFCs as its API spec. That is authenticated runtime API discovery and standard protocol documentation, not llms.txt or docs written for agents, so it counts only as adjacent support.
